Definition: Akkub, the name of five Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Akkub = "insidious"; 1) son of Elioenai and descendant of David through Zerubbabel; 2) a head of a family returning from exile; 3) head of a family of temple slaves returning from exile; 4) a Levite gatekeeper; 5) a Levite who helped Ezra expound the law to the people; 6) a Levite gatekeeper after the return from exile
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
